whenToUse: An independent photographer's portfolio: masonry wall with discipline filter, lightbox and case stories.
Visual creatives who want the work, not the copy, to lead.
avoidWhen: Architecture or design studios showing drawings and project registers — use site-portfolio-02.
Photo studios selling packages and bookings — use site-studio-01.
a11y: Give every image meaningful alt text and make sure the lightbox traps focus, closes on Escape and restores focus.
The cursor-following cover preview is pointer-only; keep the project index usable as plain links.
